svg.title: Moses move
svg.desc: The Moses move and subsequent compression in Fig. 3 of Lin, Zaletel, and Pollmann (2022). Panels (a), (b), and (c) show the initial column, its factorization, and the shifted orthogonality column. Fig. 3 from Sheng-Hsuan Lin, Michael P. Zaletel, and Frank Pollmann, Efficient Simulation of Dynamics in Two-Dimensional Quantum Spin Systems with Isometric Tensor Networks, Physical Review B 106, 245102 (2022). https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.106.245102. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Original vector panels arranged horizontally. Original notation retained; lettering converted to SVG paths.
